TAL_DEATH_SPEAK_WITH_THE_DEPARTED.why: Ritual Procedure, 10 minutes, out-of-combat questioning of the dead; no fight-table effect.

TAL_DEATH_FUNERARY_PRESERVATION.why: Ritual Procedure, 10 minutes; preserves a corpse over days, not a combat action.

TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_SERVANT.why: The talent text is a 1-hour ritual that creates a standing Corpse Servant; the servant itself is fielded via combat/rules/summons.json (source TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_SERVANT -> creature corpse_servant, already present at the start of a fight, up to Proficiency Bonus of them, commanded by Bonus Action).

TAL_DEATH_ROUSE_LESSER_DEAD.why: The talent text is a 10-minute ritual that creates a standing Lesser Corpse Servant; the servant itself is now fielded via combat/rules/summons.json (source TAL_DEATH_ROUSE_LESSER_DEAD -> creature lesser_corpse_servant, added this pass -- it had no creature at all before).

TAL_DEATH_GRAVE_SENSE.why: Always-on detection (corpses/undead/ghosts/grave Qi in range) with no numeric combat effect of its own; nothing she owns keys an in-fight mechanic off it (Bone Ward's proximity bonus checks for a corpse/bone pile/grave marker directly, not Grave Sense).

TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_SERVANT_STAT_BLOCK.why: The full stat block (AC 12+PB, HP 5xCL+key, Grave Strike 2d6+key, Poison immunity, advantage vs Exhaust/Poison/Frighten) is exactly what combat/rules/summons.json's 'corpse_servant' creature entry fields when Corpse Servant is fielded; nothing further to type on Lingfeng's own record.

TAL_DEATH_LESSER_CORPSE_SERVANT_STAT_BLO.why: AC 10+PB, HP 3xCL+key, Speed 25, Grave Strike 1d6+key, Poison immunity, Charmed/Frightened/Poisoned immunity -- all now in combat/rules/summons.json's 'lesser_corpse_servant' creature (added this pass, see Rouse Lesser Dead); nothing further to type on Lingfeng's own copy of the text.

TAL_DEATH_DEATHLESS_GUARD.why: Implemented as the corpse_servant's own Guard action + reaction in combat/summons.py's TAL_DEATH_DEATHLESS_GUARD improvement (unconditional once she owns the talent); nothing left to type on Lingfeng's own copy of the text.

tianxia.talent.death.bone_general.why: The two default improvements (+2 AC, Grave Strike +1d8 Necrotic) are already wired as a corpse_servant improvement in combat/rules/summons.json ('tianxia.talent.death.bone_general').

TAL_DEATH_CORPSE_COURIER.why: Utility adaptation for a Lesser Corpse Servant (climb speed, carry capacity, courier routes, message delivery) -- all out-of-fight logistics, no combat effect to type.

tianxia.tradition.spirit.soul_warden_nec.why: Ritual, 1 minute, out-of-combat questioning of remains; no fight-table effect.

tianxia.subpath.body.bone_monarch.featur.why: Fielded via combat/rules/summons.json (source tianxia.subpath.body.bone_monarch.feature.bone_guard_manifestation -> creature 'bone_guard'): AC 14+PB, HP 5xCL, Bone Strike 2d8+CON, and (added this pass) its own 'Guard the Sovereign' Reaction imposing Disadvantage on an attack against it or an adjacent ally. Nothing further to type on Lingfeng's own copy of the text.

TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_BORROW_THE_MONS.why: Unlocks on gaining Devoured Essence specifically 'from a beast, monstrosity, fiend, demon, aberration, or demonic beast' -- this fight table does not track opponent creature-type taxonomy, so the unlock can't be checked automatically; see the reviewed_final rider for the full reasoning.

TAL_WEAPONS_PROFILE_LESSON.why: 'When you gain a Foundation weapon specialty talent from this addendum, choose its legal weapon profile' -- a character-build prerequisite/bookkeeping note, not an activatable or passive combat effect.

tianxia.talent.weapons.qi_conduit_method.why: Printed text says outright: 'This talent by itself does not change attack or damage modifiers' -- it only qualifies her for other (unowned) talents.

tianxia.talent.weapons.hook_catch_and_tu.why: Modifies Hooking Method only on a weapon with both Hooking+Disarming or both Flexible+Returning Line properties; her equipped weapons (Heaven-Mark Violet Gold Bi Shou, Gun (Staff), Lang Ya Bang) carry none of those properties, so the modifier has no live weapon to attach to right now.

TAL_SWORD_FLOWING_WATER_SLASH.why: Triggers on a hit with a Sword-category weapon attack; she owns no Sword-tagged weapon (her kit is a Bi Shou dagger, a Gun/Staff, and a Morningstar) so there is currently no ability for this modifier to bind to.

TAL_SWORD_MERIDIAN_CUTTING_STRIKE.why: Same as Flowing Water Slash: requires a Sword weapon attack bearing her Sword Intent; she has no Sword-tagged weapon equipped.

TAL_SCOUNDREL_EMPTY_SLEEVE_HAND.why: Extends Dirty Trick and Steal, two Scoundrel talents she has not learned (only Counter Theft and Everything in the Wrong Place are on her sheet); nothing to extend yet.

DISEASE_BASE_DIAGNOSE_THE_SICKNESS.why: Pure information-gathering (what kind of infection, whether a target carries her Contagion Tokens, whether quarantine is recommended); no damage, condition, or resource change to type.
